takeaway: Epidermal cysts originate in the skin and have a characteristic punctum; they commonly occur in the head and neck.

lines.text: A thirty-four-year-old man has a firm lump on the right side of his neck, just below the mandible.
The skin appears attached to the lump,
and there is a small punctum.
That punctum is the key: epidermal cysts originate in the skin and have a characteristic punctum.
They commonly occur in the head and neck region.
So the diagnosis is an epidermal cyst.
